rules.temporary_offer_randomization_at_retriev: known rule, unimplemented; reserve choices are client-guaranteed extras

paraphrase: 获得招募券时可留存，初始可留存三张；已满时不能留存或替换旧券。仅险路尽头可取出，险路小径不提供取券。留存指保存招募券，不是消耗另一种留存券。
implementation: Concrete pending and stored ticket instance IDs are separate. Same-screen recruitment does not reroll already offered collectible/part alternatives. The policy chooses whether to take corn before recruiting.
unknowns: Temporary recruitment, randomized promotion and full operator rosters remain outside this guaranteed reserve-only action model.
The observed battle composition pools condition on recorded tickets and do not establish ticket presence probability; the pre-existing one-ticket battle reward count is unchanged.
